title: HagopJay's X3D repo family
notes: Repos are cloned beside each other under --root. Personal names and addresses are matched by the first 16 hex digits of their sha256 (lowercased), so none is written here. x3d_ai is private: only counts, times and identity classes leave the harvester for it. Lineage order is HagopJay's own account (2026-10-30).
lineage_source: HagopJay in the Geneology-VIZ project, 2026-10-30: blender-io first (gsplat), then .prov for lineage, then ML, then the private .ai repo, then .ONTO, 'and more to come'.

vocabulary_notes..prov: No .prov repo exists: the provenance stage lives in x3d.ML (x3dprov).

curated_notes: The masterclass graded its ties from a harvest of 2026-10-30; x3d.onto merged PRs #4 to #8 after that, so its x3d.onto ties may be stale.
